description: Kept reproducers of the issue 195 generative and conformance suites: inputs on which a runtime once diverged from the native tree-sitter CLI or broke a generative property. The generator adds each with its CLI tree to <language>.json; both runtimes must match it. Add an input here whenever a generative run fails (the failure message prints the seed and the source).

cases.defect: The JavaScript runtime left whitespace before the grammar root without a trivia link.
Both runtimes kept U+200B, U+2060 and U+FEFF, which the JavaScript grammar lexes as extras, as non-trivia hidden text.
The JavaScript runtime parsed UTF-16 and charged error recovery per code unit, producing (import module: (MISSING identifier)) instead of the native ERROR node.
UTF-16 error recovery closed the comment with a MISSING node instead of the native ERROR node.
Whitespace after the grammar root had a source token but no trivia link in the JavaScript runtime.

cases.defect: Not a runtime defect: two leading blank lines change the error recovery of this malformed input in the native CLI too, so the prepend-blank-lines relation is only required of clean trees.

cases.found: issue 195 run-time generative fuzz, seed g, case 45
cases.defect: Not a runtime defect: the tree-sitter lexer skips U+FEFF only at byte 0, so after two leading blank lines the native CLI parses it as an error too, and the prepend-blank-lines relation excludes inputs that start with a byte-order mark.
